text:
sam_sales: Heads-up — LumaBank just submitted a security questionnaire (SIG + a few custom control asks) for the upcoming POC. They want CAIQ mapping, data-flow confirmation, KMS details, and audit log retention. Deadline is Fri EOD. Drive link attached: https://drive.redwood/lumabank/qna. Can someone pick this up? @maria_security

maria_security: I can take ownership of the intake/triage. Quick q: is the POC Hosted or Dedicated? Need to confirm who manages keys and where logs live before I start the SIG answers.

sam_sales: POC will be on Dedicated per customer request — VPC peering. They emphasized customer-managed keys (CMEK) possibility and asked about telemetry. Contact at Luma: Emily (emily@lumabank.com) and infra lead Raj.

alex_pss: I'll handle the POC onboarding + runbook for the customer side. Maria — I'll gather the CAIQ template mapping and paste a redacted data-flow diagram here. Also will coordinate the Dedicated capacity config.

maria_security: Great. Please include: network zones, where ephemeral caches live, audit log sinks, and any 3rd-party telemetry. Also they asked for SOC2 evidence for specific controls — we'll likely need Customer Success to obtain consent to share the report.

alex_pss: Uploading quick diagram snippet: ```net -> LB -> Redwood Dedicated (VPC peering) -> GPU pool
KMS: customer-managed via AWS KMS (CMK)
Logs: CloudWatch -> S3 (encrypted, SSE-KMS)
Cache: local ephemeral KV on GPU nodes (no user PII cached)```

olivia_sre: FYI for Dedicated clusters we default to 90d log retention. We can provision a shorter retention if contract requires it — that'll need an exception ticket. CC eng-sre for any infra changes.

security_bot: Ticket SEC-2026-459 created and assigned to maria_security. Due date set to 2026-02-14. (automated)

maria_security: I'll draft the SIG/CAIQ responses and flag any gaps where we need artifacts (SOC2, penetration test summary). Expect an initial draft in ~24h. Alex — please upload the full redacted diagram and any network ACLs so I can reference them.

sam_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks. Also note the customer asked whether CMEK will change pricing. If there is a measurable delta, call it out in the POC pricing note.

alex_pss: CMEK has a small setup effort; main recurring is KMS API usage. I'll run a quick estimate and post numbers in this thread.

maria_security: Action items assigned: alex_pss (POC infra artifacts + pricing estimate), olivia_sre (log retention variance and exception path), sam_sales (confirm SOC2 access permission with Emily), maria_security (SIG/CAIQ draft).

sam_sales: Confirmed. tagging Emily at Luma: emily@lumabank.com — we've started the intake and will follow up with the CAIQ draft tomorrow.

maria_security: Thanks team — I'll update the ticket as I make progress. If we hit blocker on SOC2 access, I'll escalate to legal/customer success.

sam_sales: Perfect, appreciate it.
